title: Leap Year
tagline: Propose on the twenty-ninth. Eat stew on the thirtieth.
about: A woman travels to Ireland to propose to her boyfriend on Leap Day and ends up crossing the country with a grumpy innkeeper.
cue: Serve the mains when Mr and Mrs O'Bradycallaghan kiss at the B&B dinner.
